findings.evidence: Homepage: plain HTTP fetch yielded 0 words and no noscript fallback (26 words). Rendered page evidence is unavailable in this environment, so this is a one-sided finding: static HTML alone is effectively blank to a non-rendering client.

suggested_action.summary: Implement SSR/SSG or a meaningful loading state and noscript fallback.

findings.title: Blank first paint with no fallback

findings.evidence: No sentence in the first 300 words explicitly names the organisation, its category, and its function.

suggested_action.summary: Add one clear declarative sentence near the top of the homepage or about page naming the organisation, its category, and its function.

findings.title: No explicit organisation-definition sentence

suggested_action.summary: Add a consistent, self-referential rel=canonical to every indexable page.

findings.evidence: No sameAs declarations or outbound identity-profile links found on the homepage or about page.

suggested_action.summary: Declare identity anchors: add sameAs to the Organization JSON-LD pointing at the organisation's authoritative external profiles.

findings.title: No declared identity anchors

findings.evidence: Page https://www.booking.com/: missing <main> landmark. Violates structural conventions (WCAG 2.2 SC 1.3.1).

suggested_action.summary: Add <main> to wrap primary content; fix heading level skips.

findings.title: Missing landmark or heading structure

suggested_action.summary: Add or complete an Organization JSON-LD block with at minimum 'name' and 'url'.

limitations.reason: Actual agreement across the wider web about the brand's facts requires a search or web-scale index API. No free, deterministic, rate-safe source exists.
limitations.note: CHK-D-025/026/027 audit only the anchoring the site itself provides for that corroboration, not corroboration itself.

limitations.reason: Detecting a same-name collision with an unrelated entity requires a corpus of other entities.
limitations.note: CHK-D-027 covers only self-consistency, the site-side half.

limitations.reason: Live-querying a generative engine would break determinism, the 5-minute budget, and reproducibility.
limitations.note: This audit measures retrievability and correctness of what the site exposes, never observed citation outcomes.

limitations.reason: Field engagement outcomes (bounce, dwell, scroll, conversion, task success) are not observable read-only.
limitations.note: Reported not_determinable where the gap is itself actionable.

limitations.reason: llms.txt is not recommended as a substantive fix: a 137k-domain measurement found 97% of existing llms.txt files were never requested. This audit declines to recommend adding one on that evidence (D-007).
limitations.note: Stated here rather than omitted (D-014) — the officials' Q&A confirms recommending it is an acceptable position, so silence about it would look indistinguishable from having missed it.
